source.question: Use Atom selectors in Subjects, keeping the Atom as owner rather than making Content Role allowed values own its properties?
source.answer: yes, good. but dont mess Atom and atom

distinct_tokens.Atom: The Entity type in the model.
distinct_tokens.atom: The selector notation atom(...); not another spelling of the Entity type.

decision.property_ownership: Properties remain owned by the selected Atom. A Content Role allowed value does not become their bearer.

limits: The exact lowercase selector form atom(...) and uppercase Entity name Atom stay distinct.
No case-folding or interchange of these tokens is approved.
